subject: Multi-PO consolidation: VAT IDs, usage attestations, and SLA cascade
messages:
From: Samuel Ng <samuel.ng@cloudpillar.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudpillar.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal consolidation — VAT & usage attestations needed

Hi Olga / Kim,

We're consolidating three existing Marketplace POs into a single private-offer and need to supply two things for our finance and tax teams before they can sign:

- VAT registration certificates for Redwood (EU legal entities) or a vendor declaration for reverse charge.
- Usage attestations for the prior 12 months (token counts / spend per region) to align forecasting for the new commit.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a scanned VAT cert for the EU entity and a CSV export of usage by month & region? We also want to map the existing PO lines to the consolidation schedule so Procurement can validate billing.

Thanks — if useful, loop in legal/finance.

Best,
Samuel Ng
CloudPillar — Procurement

Attachments referenced: (none in this initial message)
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Samuel Ng <samuel.ng@cloudpillar.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal consolidation — VAT & usage attestations needed

Samuel,

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to support consolidation. Quick plan from our side:

1) VAT evidence — I will request the EU VAT cert from Finance and confirm whether we can provide a vendor declaration for reverse charge. Expect a PDF within 48 business hours.
2) Usage export — Marissa will pull the month-by-month token and spend export by region (CSV) and a short mapping doc tying each PO line-item to the consolidated schedule.
3) SLA cascade & billing mapping — Kim and Markus will own a short note describing how the consolidated PO maps to SLA tiers and any changes to throughput commitments. This is important for your ops and legal.

Marissa: can you attach the consolidated schedule template (xlsx) and estimated turnaround?
Kim / Markus: can you flag any known SLA implications for an aggregated PO that might matter to Procurement?

We will attach the VAT cert and the usage CSV in a follow-up thread and provide a DocuSign-ready private-offer once Procurement confirms acceptance of the mapping.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: AWS_Private_Offer_Consolidation_Schedule.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — that schedule looks good. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- Legal entity: CloudPillar EU (we need EU VAT alignment).
- We attached here the VAT certificate for our side; can Redwood attach its EU VAT cert or a signed vendor declaration? Procurement won't accept the consolidation without one.
- On the usage CSV: Procurement also asks for a short attestation statement that the usage export is complete and hasn’t been materially adjusted for refunds/credits — that helps their internal auditors.
- One more operational item — when you propose the SLA cascade in the consolidated PO, can you include how latency SLOs map to the new throughput blocks (we have two critical regions: eu-central-1 and eu-west-2)? If there are any delta commitments we should budget for, flag them now.

I've attached CloudPillar's VAT cert (CloudPillar_VAT_Certificate.pdf) for your records. Will await your files.

Best,
Samuel

Attachments: CloudPillar_VAT_Certificate.pdf
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samuel Ng <samuel.ng@cloudpillar.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed next steps and DocuSign readiness for consolidation

Samuel / Marissa / Olga / Kim,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Short summary and next steps from Ops & Legal readiness POV:

1) VAT evidence — Finance confirmed we can provide the EU VAT cert for Redwood Europe B.V.; PDF attached in a separate secure share. If Procurement prefers a vendor declaration, we can provide a signed letter the same day.
2) Usage attestation — Marissa will finalize the CSV and include a one-paragraph attestation. That attestation text will read: "Redwood Inference certifies that the attached usage export is a complete and accurate extract of billable usage for the period 2025-08-01 to 2026-07-31 and excludes refunds/credits except where explicitly noted." Please confirm if Procurement wants additional legal language.
3) SLA cascade — for the consolidated purchase we propose the following mapping (short):
   - Consolidated block A (0-1.2M tokens/day) -> retain current latency SLO (95th pctl < 150ms) in eu-central-1 and eu-west-2.
   - Consolidated block B (>1.2M tokens/day) -> small uplift to burst capacity; a 30-day notice for predictable ramp.
If CloudPillar requires hard SLA credits for the higher block, we need to discuss billing uplift.
4) DocuSign — once Procurement confirms legal entity and the mapping, we'll produce a DocuSign private-offer. ETA: 48 hours after confirmation. Link will be posted to the deal record: https://app.redwood.com/deals/RW-CP-2026-0892

Marissa: please send the CSV + attestation and I will coordinate with Legal for any extra wording.
Kim: please flag any commercial uplift that should be presented as an optional add-on in the private-offer.

I'll BCC Kim on the DocuSign notification so Finance sees the signature timeline.

Thanks all — close loop once you confirm entity and accept the proposed SLA cascade.

-Markus Klein
Director, Platform Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Europe_VAT_Certificate.pdf (secure share), draft attestation (to be appended to CSV)
